color.note: Night, the only wired theme. Light (glass) stays unwired dead code in src/tokens.ts; its values are in the README.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything; also the dial dot and the gap ring around a picked swatch.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on page, card, cardOn, panel, chip and modal (about 17:1 on page). Also the solid fill of primary buttons, picked choices and the on switch.

tokens.name: ink2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: sublines, facts' labels, idle device words, a card's timer (8.2:1 on page, 7.4:1 on cardOn).

tokens.name: ink3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and quiet icons: captions, chart ticks, group labels, an off power icon. 4.2:1 on page and 4.0:1 on card, below 4.5:1: the source value is kept, so use it only for small labels that repeat what's beside them, never for something Andy must read to decide.

tokens.name: head
tokens.usage: Section headings (Lights, Climate, Other devices) and their counts, on page.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: An off or idle card's fill (light, AC, Other devices, utility cards).

tokens.name: cardOn
tokens.usage: An on card's fill, and a lit half of the door lock card.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: An off card's 1px border, the sidebar's and the chips' border.

tokens.name: edgeOn
tokens.usage: An on card's border; modal, popover and pill-button borders; the door lock seam.

tokens.name: edgeHover
tokens.usage: An off card's border under the pointer (mouse and trackpad only).

tokens.name: edgeOnHover
tokens.usage: An on card's border under the pointer.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The desktop sidebar's fill.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Status chips' fill, and the Cancel pill in an inline Turn off all.

tokens.name: sub
tokens.usage: Subtle fills: power and icon buttons, steppers, tracks, grouped sections, tiles, Settings row groups. The first hover step over transparent.

tokens.name: sub2
tokens.usage: The next step: a picked segment or range, switch tracks, text buttons, the device action. Hover from sub.

tokens.name: sub3
tokens.usage: The hover step above sub2.

tokens.name: cool
tokens.usage: Cooling, the washer, detected motion or presence, rain; text or fills on any dark surface.

tokens.name: warm
tokens.usage: Heat, the dryer, an open door, queued, warnings and unsaved-change dots; text or fills on any dark surface.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Something's off but hasn't failed: the door lock locked while the door is open (word, title icon and card edge).

tokens.name: comf
tokens.usage: Comfortable readings, printing, done, Happening now, a saved Settings bar.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: A gas price going down.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The forecast's sun and lightning only, brighter than the accents so thin icons read as yellow.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Alerts and failures: alert chips' fill, a failed card's edge and subline, Overdue, jams.

tokens.name: onAlert
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an alert fill (alert chips, the Disconnected pill).

tokens.name: onInk
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (solid buttons, picked choices, the brightness tooltip).

tokens.name: onAccent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (chart tags, the lit Chamber light).

tokens.name: modal
tokens.usage: Modal, sheet and popover surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind an open modal or sheet.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines: modal header rule, fact rows, Sessions days, sidebar tracker and weather rules.

tokens.name: stripe
tokens.usage: Hatching for offline halves and empty placeholders (135deg, 3px on, 5px off).

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: The 10px scrollbar thumb, with a 3px transparent inset, on a transparent track. Every scrolling area uses it.

tokens.name: onGlow
tokens.usage: A lit light's badge icon and the brightness bar's icon, on the light's glow.

tokens.name: glow-dimmable
tokens.usage: The glow of a dimmable-only light: its card's wash, badge, power tint and brightness bar.

tokens.name: glow-warm-white
tokens.usage: A white-ambiance light at 2200 K; glows interpolate from here through glow-neutral-white to glow-cool-white.

tokens.name: glow-neutral-white
tokens.usage: A white-ambiance light at 4350 K, the ramp's midpoint.

tokens.name: glow-cool-white
tokens.usage: A white-ambiance light at 6500 K.

tokens.name: chart-power
tokens.usage: Power charts' mean line and min–max band. Every chart hue is oklch(0.8 0.11 <hue>); this one is 55.

tokens.name: chart-month-to-date
tokens.usage: Monthly Usage and the fridge's This month cumulative kWh line. Every chart hue is oklch(0.8 0.11 <hue>); this one is 165.

tokens.name: chart-lights
tokens.usage: Lights' on/off strip. Every chart hue is oklch(0.8 0.11 <hue>); this one is 75.

tokens.name: chart-doors
tokens.usage: Doors' on/off strip, and the door lock chart's Door lane. Every chart hue is oklch(0.8 0.11 <hue>); this one is 55.

tokens.name: chart-motion
tokens.usage: Motion and presence strips. Every chart hue is oklch(0.8 0.11 <hue>); this one is 235.

tokens.name: chart-washer
tokens.usage: Washer stage strips. Every chart hue is oklch(0.8 0.11 <hue>); this one is 235.

tokens.name: chart-leak
tokens.usage: The leak sensor's strip. Every chart hue is oklch(0.8 0.11 <hue>); this one is 25.

tokens.name: chart-costco
tokens.usage: The car's Costco price line. Every chart hue is oklch(0.8 0.11 <hue>); this one is 235.

tokens.name: chart-shell
tokens.usage: The car's Shell price line. Every chart hue is oklch(0.8 0.11 <hue>); this one is 55.

tokens.name: chart-chevron
tokens.usage: The car's Chevron price line. Every chart hue is oklch(0.8 0.11 <hue>); this one is 300.

tokens.name: chart-fridge-door
tokens.usage: The fridge's Fridge door lane. Every chart hue is oklch(0.8 0.11 <hue>); this one is 55.

tokens.name: chart-freezer-door
tokens.usage: The fridge's Freezer door lane. Every chart hue is oklch(0.8 0.11 <hue>); this one is 235.

tokens.name: chart-coolselect-door
tokens.usage: The fridge's CoolSelect+ door lane. Every chart hue is oklch(0.8 0.11 <hue>); this one is 300.

tokens.name: chart-lock
tokens.usage: The door lock chart's Lock lane (unlocked periods). Every chart hue is oklch(0.8 0.11 <hue>); this one is 300.

tokens.name: chart-wind
tokens.usage: The weather modal's wind line; rain uses cool. Every chart hue is oklch(0.8 0.11 <hue>); this one is 195.

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: Large numbers are weight 300 with negative tracking, tabular figures wherever a value changes.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The desktop clock; its PM is clock-suffix in ink2. 46px on the phone.

styles.name: modal-status
styles.usage: A modal's big status and a history chart's headline (34px on the phone); and an AC card's target, the setpoint hero (36px in a card under 240px inside, 48px on the phone).

styles.name: other-value
styles.usage: An Other devices card's status word; 23px in a card under 116px.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Geist 300–600; titles 500, everything else 400. Body line height 1.35.

styles.name: modal-title
styles.usage: A modal's title, clamped to 2 lines.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section and utility card headings, in head.

styles.name: light-title
styles.usage: Light and AC card titles; lights clamp to 2 lines.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body text, facts and section counts.

styles.name: subline
styles.usage: Card sublines and button labels, in ink2.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chips, and small labels in ink3.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, tooltips, device quiet lines, chart ticks.

styles.name: group-label
styles.usage: Agenda group and Settings nav labels: uppercase (text-transform), in ink3; Overdue in alert.

spacing.note: The desktop page at 1728 × 1117 and 1728 × 1000. Spacing is per element, copied from the stylesheet, not a grid.

tokens.name: space-page
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop (16px sides on the phone).

tokens.name: space-gap
tokens.usage: Between the sidebar and main, the controls and the utility column, and inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: space-content
tokens.usage: Between the content row and the chip row; between utility cards.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Between the Lights, Climate and Other devices sections; between modal content blocks.

tokens.name: space-card-grid
tokens.usage: Between cards in a section, and between a section's bar and its cards.

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: Light and AC card padding (a light card's bottom is 22px, clear of the brightness bar); device cards use 14px 12px.

tokens.name: space-modal
tokens.usage: A desktop modal's header and body side padding (20px in the phone sheet).

tokens.name: space-chip
tokens.usage: Between chips; 14px after the last alert chip.

radius.note: Pills for controls, then a step down per nesting level.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, pills, steppers, toggles, power and icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: The phone sheet's top corners only.

tokens.name: radius-modal
tokens.usage: The desktop modal and the Settings modal.

tokens.name: radius-sidebar
tokens.usage: The desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: radius-utility
tokens.usage: Agenda, Mail and Car cards (18px on the phone).

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: Light, AC and Other devices cards.

tokens.name: radius-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers.

tokens.name: radius-group
tokens.usage: Grouped sections inside details, Settings row groups, the print tile.

tokens.name: radius-info
tokens.usage: Info boxes, banners, temperature and tyre tiles, cells.

tokens.name: radius-segment
tokens.usage: Segmented controls, switch tiles, choices, sliders.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: The desktop modal (the phone sheet has none).

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers and the Settings confirmation.

tokens.name: shadow-disconnected
tokens.usage: The Disconnected pill.

layout.note: Fixed sizes from DESIGN.md's Desktop layout and Modal; the page never scrolls on desktop.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: The sidebar's width (312px under 1600px).

tokens.name: size-utility
tokens.usage: The utility column's width (384px under 1600px).

tokens.name: size-chip-row
tokens.usage: The chip row's height, and a chip's.

tokens.name: size-modal-margin
tokens.usage: A modal's height is capped at the viewport less this.

tokens.name: size-phone-max
tokens.usage: Below this card width (a container query, never the viewport) the phone layout applies.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: The phone's minimum touch target.

tokens.name: size-sheet-bottom
tokens.usage: The phone sheet's minimum bottom padding, clear of the home indicator.

tokens.name: modal-wide
tokens.usage: AC, fridge and Settings modals (Settings is 1040 × 720).

tokens.name: modal-standard
tokens.usage: Light, washer, room, leak and door lock modals.

tokens.name: modal-h2d
tokens.usage: The H2D modal.

tokens.name: modal-mail
tokens.usage: The Mail modal.

tokens.name: modal-car
tokens.usage: The Car modal.

tokens.name: modal-agenda
tokens.usage: The Agenda modal.

tokens.name: modal-weather
tokens.usage: The weather modal.

tokens.name: modal-dryer
tokens.usage: The dryer modal.

duration.note: Motion is kept regardless of OS reduced-motion preferences.

tokens.name: dur-s
tokens.usage: Small moves: hover, a popover's fade and close, a card's press.

tokens.name: dur-m
tokens.usage: Medium: borders, switches, a popover's scale, a modal closing into its card.

tokens.name: dur-l
tokens.usage: Large: a modal opening from its card (FLIP), fills and glows, chips growing in.

tokens.name: press-to-open
tokens.usage: A pressed card settles before its modal opens.

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: Hold power to open the timer: the ring starts after 120ms and fills over 380ms.

tokens.name: content-height
tokens.usage: A modal's content changing height eases this long; a run of changes finishes within 220ms.

tokens.name: brightness-tip-fade
tokens.usage: The brightness tooltip fades this long after release.

tokens.name: pending-pulse
tokens.usage: The waiting pulse: opacity 1 → .38, ease-in-out, repeating.

tokens.name: commit
tokens.usage: A run of stepper or brightness-key presses sends one change this long after the last.

tokens.name: confirm
tokens.usage: HA must confirm a control's change within this, or the card says it didn't respond.

tokens.name: ease-std
tokens.usage: Every transition, opening and closing alike.

tokens.name: ease-content
tokens.usage: A modal's content height (daymark's ease).

tokens.name: opacity-pulse-low
tokens.usage: The pending pulse's low point.

tokens.name: opacity-unavailable
tokens.usage: An unavailable light or AC card, with its dashed edge (.55 for Other devices).

tokens.name: opacity-inert
tokens.usage: Inert steppers, choices and disabled pills.

tokens.name: opacity-disconnected
tokens.usage: The page while disconnected, in greyscale.
